title: Balconies unscreened for at least 25% of the total balcony perimeter
text: C1.1.2 Balconies are to be unscreened for at least 25% of the total perimeter of the balcony (refer Figure 1.1a). Figure 1.1a note: Boundary perimeter length = A + B + C + D. Minimum 25% of balcony perimeter to be unscreened. Total balcony perimeter to include sides that abut building walls.

replaces.note: R10-R25: no Part B equivalent (more restrictive for low-coded apartments)

notes: New here (no Chapter 3 equivalent; ch3 C1.1.2 is the OLA in the street setback area). Applies where any apartment has a balcony (rule condition, proposed fact dwellings.balconies_provided). Fact is the lowest unscreened share of any balcony. Figure 1.1a: perimeter = A+B+C+D including sides that abut building walls; the 1.6 m high fixed screen is the screened portion.
